title: Filter Non-Gold Versions
description:
A build pipeline logs every release to the `builds` table. Only builds in one of two approved formats are promoted:

- **Numeric** — three dot-separated integers, no leading `v`, no extra characters (e.g. `1.0.0`, `12.3.456`)
- **Gold** — the exact string `gold`, nothing else

Write a query to return the `id` and `version` of every build that does **not** match either approved format. Return the result in any order.
hint: Anchored alternatives `(^...$)|(^...$)` match either whole pattern. Wrap the test in NOT to keep only rows that match neither.
outputExplanation:
- `1.2.3` — three dot-separated integers, no prefix. Approved — not returned. ✓
- `gold` — exact match for the gold format. Approved — not returned. ✓
- `golden` — starts with `gold` but has extra characters; `^gold$` requires nothing after it. Returned. ✗
- `v1.2.3` — has a leading `v`; the numeric pattern allows no prefix. Returned. ✗
- `1.2` — only two segments; the pattern requires exactly three. Returned. ✗

Rows 3, 4, and 5 are returned.
